invariants.name: testFuzz_INVA_floorInInertRangeNeverBinds
invariants.description: For amount=100e18, R in [0,1e18] and minPhUSDOut in [0,amount] fuzzed independently, annihilate never reverts InsufficientPhUSDOut and the caller's stablecoin is consumed in every case.

invariants.name: test_INVA_boundary_floorEqualsAmount_atZeroRate
invariants.description: minPhUSDOut == amount exactly, at R = 0 (the worst case).

invariants.name: test_INVA_control_oneWeiAboveTheRangeDoesBind
invariants.description: minPhUSDOut = amount+1 DOES revert InsufficientPhUSDOut(amount+1, amount) - the check is alive, the range is merely inert.

invariants.name: invariant_A_floorInInertRangeNeverBinds
invariants.description: Across the whole stateful campaign, zero annihilate reverts carried the InsufficientPhUSDOut selector for a floor drawn from [0, amount].

invariants.name: invariant_A_tripwire_boundaryFloorWasExercised
invariants.description: Once 20 feasible annihilations have settled, the boundary draw minPhUSDOut == amount must have occurred at least once.

invariants.name: testFuzz_INVB_shortfallIsExact_18dec
invariants.description: 18-decimal stable: mintedForStable == amount*R/1e18 exactly; shortfall == amount*(1e18-R)/1e18.

invariants.name: testFuzz_INVB_shortfallIsExact_6dec
invariants.description: 6-decimal stable on its representable lattice: same exactness, no rounding edge.

invariants.name: test_INVB_refutes_lowRateZeroClaim
invariants.description: R=1 wei yields 100 wei phUSD on a 100e18 pair; R=1e15 yields 0.1 phUSD. The stable leg is zero only at R==0.

invariants.name: test_INVC_midCallInjectionIsForwarded
invariants.description: 500e18 phUSD injected from the stable's transfer hook between phUSDBefore and the mintedForStable delta is forwarded: 700e18 delivered on a 100e18 pair.

invariants.name: test_INVC_injectionFollowsCallerChosenRecipient
invariants.description: The injected value follows the caller-chosen `recipient`, not the donor.

invariants.name: test_INVC_injectionSatisfiesAFloorTheQuoteAloneWouldNot
invariants.description: Injected value clears a minPhUSDOut floor that the honest quote alone would fail - the floor cannot distinguish injected phUSD from minted phUSD.

invariants.name: testFuzz_INVC_forwardedSurplusEqualsInjection
invariants.description: Forwarded surplus tracks the injected quantity exactly across [1, 1000e18].

invariants.name: test_CTRL_noBurnSurfaceOutsideAnnihilation
invariants.description: burn(uint256), burnFrom(address,uint256), burn(address,uint256) are all unreachable; no fallback; zero-address transfer rejected; annihilation is the sole supply reduction.

invariants.name: test_CTRL_wholeOrNothing_failedLegLeavesNoPartialState
invariants.description: A failing stable deposit leg leaves no burned antimatter, no consumed stablecoin, no residue and no standing allowance.

invariants.name: invariant_3_wholeOrNothing_noResidue
invariants.description: No stable or phUSD residue on Antimatter beyond ghost-tracked donations, throughout the campaign.

invariants.name: invariant_00_tripwire_annihilationActuallyHappened
invariants.description: Precondition-aware: once 5 FEASIBLE annihilate attempts (funded + approved) have been made, at least one must have settled.

invariants.name: test_ZZ_tripwireIsFalsifiable
invariants.description: Two halves: revoked approvals make attempts infeasible and the tripwire correctly stays silent; a paused yield strategy makes them feasible-but-failing and the tripwire's condition IS met with a recorded liveness violation.
